# Osay Kancuno (K4NCUN0)

> Osay Kancuno (K4NCUN0, @OsayKancuno) is an artist and builder on-chain. He made THE K.LAB (https://www.kancuno.com/klab) and its fully on-chain collection K1N0 on Ethereum. He also runs side quests, on-chain and off-chain, like JAMVERSE.

## Key facts

- Name: Osay Kancuno. Also known as K4NCUN0, Kancuno, @OsayKancuno.
- Role: artist and builder on-chain. Creator of THE K.LAB and the K1N0 collection. Side quests: experiments on-chain and off-chain.
- Motto: "Culture belongs to the people who create it."
- Founder of: Normies Yacht Club (https://normiesyachtclub.com/: pixel-art yachts that live entirely on Ethereum, each one born from a burned Normie; CC0).
- Creator of: 8362 Coffee (https://8362coffee.com/), a real-world coffee brand tied to Normie #8362.

## Side quests (experiments)

- On the home page this chapter is titled "Side quests"; it was called "The lab" before, not to be confused with THE K.LAB.
- EXP. 001 · Off-chain · Live: JAMVERSE (https://jamverse.kancuno.com/). A live music universe in 3D: make a full song alone or jam it with friends in real time. Every part (drums, bass, chords, melody, texture, voice) is a ring you can step into. Step sequencer, piano roll, song arranger and mixer; one tap turns a loop into a full song; export WAV, stems or MIDI; a new seed challenge every day. Free, in the browser.
- More experiments, on-chain and off-chain, are in the works.

## THE K.LAB

- https://www.kancuno.com/klab: THE K.LAB, an open creative lab around K1N0: an open character with no owner (seven head blocks over an X), public domain under CC0, to remix and make your own, in 3D plus a flat vector version. Started by Osay Kancuno. "One symbol. Infinite variations." Featured first on the home page; separate from the side quests.
- Free tools in the browser, no wallet, no gas: K Editor (colours, gradients, patterns, neon, glitch, pixel, undo/redo, PNG/SVG/JSON export), Pixel Forge (pixel-art grids with the K1N0 preset), Animation Bench (loops, GIF and video export), SVG Suite (optimise SVG, base files), Touch Field (move the pointer over K1N0 in 3D and the blocks make way, like on the home page; record a clip), Image Wrap (put your own picture on K1N0 in 3D, across the figure or on every block; it never leaves the browser). K1N0 can be turned and zoomed in 3D in every tool. Optional mint: K1N0, the collection THE K.LAB on Ethereum (8,362 in all, 0.0024 ETH, numbers 1-8,362 chosen by the minter or at random): K1N0 in clay-like 3D, the X and four head blocks always black, with four colours of its own (background, centre, two front blocks), each combination minted once, and the colours never change; holders give each colour an effect and set the 3D view for the gas only, the latest look is what the image, the 3D piece and OpenSea show, and every look is kept on-chain with who set it. Image, interactive 3D piece and metadata are fully on-chain.
- License: K1N0 and its base files are public domain under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Anyone may use, remix and sell them, commercial work included, with no permission or credit needed.
- K Editor has two modes: K1N0 mode (the default: the black X and four head blocks stay black, four colours from the 16 of the palette, the on-chain look, and the stage is the contract's own 3D piece, so what you see is what you mint) and Free remix (everything can change, CC0, not mintable). THE K.LAB's mark and starting design is a K1N0 on cream with a pink centre and lime front blocks (grid background, glowing fronts); the K4NCUN0 logo is K1N0 #0, the artist's own piece.
- Light rules: K1N0 stays recognisable (seven head blocks, one X); total freedom on colours, textures, effects and backgrounds. Base files (SVG, wireframe, pixel grid, starter JSON) are downloadable.
- Creation is off-chain. Minting is optional ("Mint this K1N0" in the Lab); every tool shows live whether the design can be minted as it is, what the mint would change and whether its colours are still free. The 3D view the design is framed in becomes its first look. Wallets: Rabby, MetaMask, Coinbase Wallet and other installed wallets, or WalletConnect on any phone. K1N0 is live on Ethereum mainnet: contract 0x25c8518e54b7cbb6cfe16d11bda5d543fb9e397f, collection on OpenSea https://opensea.io/collection/the-klab, token pages https://www.kancuno.com/klab/token?id=N; holders find their pieces and change their look at https://www.kancuno.com/klab/mine. Anyone can try a look on a token page and share it as a link (?look=); only the holder can save it on-chain. Gallery Wall and Prompt Lab are coming.

## Communities (context)

- The Normies: member and holder of THE100 (https://www.normies.art/). On-chain PFP: Normie #8362. Builder of free community tools for The Normies.
- JPEG Frens: holder who contributes to the community with The Frens Forge (a burn-and-forge game on The Wall Arcade by SuperRare Studio: https://kx499cjd.srstudio.dev/) and FRENS AFTER DARK, a video mini-series for JPEG Frens (Seasons 1 and 2, on X).
- NFC: holder who contributes to the community; one of the "People of the Wall" at NFC 2027 (NFC Summit, Lisbon, 27-29 May 2027, Unicorn Factory): his name K4NCUN0 is painted on the event's wall, Panel #33, category "Builders".
